lines.text: @sai_front pries open a can of @paint_blue and stirs it slowly.
He rolls a bright blue stripe across the white wall.
He steps back and tilts his head.
A second, wider stripe follows. The wall comes alive.
Morning light catches the wet blue, glowing against the white.
@sai_front grins, roller dripping onto the floor sheet.
Now that is the right blue.

writes.note: I drafted a one-room scene from your line: one stripe, a step back, then a grin and a short line.

reply.rationale: Built the scene around the existing action, using only the refs given (@sai_front, @paint_blue); six action lines plus a six-word line total about 14.4 s by rule 10.
